name: Vanilla Ice Cream Sundae with Blueberry-Peach Sauce & Almonds

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pit. Medium dice the flesh and place in a medium saucepan.
Wash, dry, and add blueberries to the saucepan with the peaches.
Add water, sugar, and vanilla to the saucepan, then stir to combine. Bring to a simmer over medium-high heat, stirring the fruit occasionally.
instructions.secondary_message:
89 ml (⅜ cup) water
⅓ cup granulated sugar
2 tbsp vanilla extract

instructions.primary_message: Once the fruit mixture is simmering, reduce heat to medium. Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until the fruit is soft, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl, make a slurry by whisking water and cornstarch until smooth.

When the fruit is soft, add cornstarch slurry to the saucepan in a steady stream, stirring constantly. Return to a simmer and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens, about 4 minutes.
Remove sauce from heat and transfer to a heatproof bowl. Place in the fridge to cool, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, place almonds in a skillet. Set over medium heat and cook, stirring frequently, until lightly toasted, about 4 minutes. Transfer to another small bowl and set aside to cool.

To serve, place one scoop of ice cream in the bottom of each bowl; top with half of the blueberry-peach sauce. Place a second scoop of ice cream on top, drizzle with remaining sauce, and sprinkle with toasted almonds. Enjoy!
